definitions.explanation: A visible sign left by something.
What is left after something is gone.

examples.japanese: ⟦{足跡|あしあと}→足跡：04095_ashiato⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}っている→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
⟦{雪|ゆき}→雪：00584_yuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{動物|どうぶつ}→動物：01480_doubutsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{足跡|あしあと}→足跡：04095_ashiato⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}っていた→残る：01187_nokoru⟧。
examples.english: Animal footprints remained in the snow.

examples.japanese: ⟦{城|しろ}→城：03255_shiro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{跡|あと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{訪|たず}ねた→訪ねる：01182_tazuneru⟧。

examples.english: Flowers were blooming on the remains of the fire.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{遺跡|いせき}→遺跡：09527_iseki⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦{文明|ぶんめい}→文明：03611_bunmei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{跡|あと}⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: These ruins are the remains of an ancient civilization.

notes:
{跡|あと} means a trace, mark, or remains left by something.

COMPOUNDS:
- ⟦{足跡|あしあと}→足跡：04095_ashiato⟧: footprint
- ⟦{傷跡|きずあと}→傷跡：14893_kizuato⟧: scar
- ⟦{痕跡|こんせき}→痕跡：10924_konseki⟧: trace, evidence
- ⟦{遺跡|いせき}→遺跡：09527_iseki⟧: ruins, archaeological site
- ⟦{跡継|あとつ}ぎ→跡継ぎ：14299_atotsugi⟧: successor, heir
- ⟦{跡形|あとかた}→跡形：26012_atokata⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧: without a trace

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {跡|あと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{残|のこ}す→残す：01975_nokosu⟧: to leave a trace
- {跡|あと}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{追|お}う→追う：02016_ou⟧: to follow in someone's footsteps
- {跡|あと}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{残|のこ}る→残る：01187_nokoru⟧: a mark remains

WATCH OUT:
- {跡|あと}: trace, mark (physical remnant)
- ⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧: after, behind, later (time/position)
These are different words despite same reading.
